hypothesis: Native64 QFormer with LFQ-only motion IDs directly interfaces with frozen GaussianGPT64-dimensional continuous sparse state. Test adjacent-state reconstruction and whether correct motion IDs improve over holding the initial state.
scope: Oracle posterior motion reconstruction, not autoregressive future prediction; all endpoints are single instants
data: All177 NeoVerse states of buildingblock_tower_17_176 and176 adjacent pairs t->t+1

qformer.endpoint_input: Aligned union of continuous source/target encoder features, difference, occupancy flags anddt
qformer.spatial_position: 3D coordinates in fixed normalized clip world; added Fourier features
qformer.implementation: Pinned VideoWorld1 cross-attention QFormer equations/modules, native64 external and attention widths, 4heads x16, FFN64->256->64, added endpoint key-validity mask. No query self-attention. GaussianGPT architecture and weights unchanged.

motion_quantizer.fairness: User selected LFQ only. Old512-FSQ results are contextual references: width, quantizer and batch/update schedule change together, so no single-factor causal attribution is permitted.

state_quantizer: None: continuous frozen encoder features are used directly
condition: Decoder reads initial integer sparse coordinates and continuous Nx64 features, four LFQ motion IDs and dt only; no future coordinates/features at decode

support.rule: Chebyshev dilation of initial coarse latent coordinates only
support.future_coverage: 100% of all176 adjacent TRAIN endpoint supports must be covered; otherwise stop without truncation
support.calibration_evidence: Every one of176 adjacent TRAIN pairs must have100% target support covered by the fixed initial-only radius6 domain

train.batch: Four complete variable-length adjacent pairs per optimizer update; joint QFormer and quantizer batch, each GaussianGPT render evaluated separately and losses averaged over four. No gradient accumulation.
train.frozen: Entire new continuous state E/D including adapters and GS heads; LFQ removed; parameter hashes checked
train.target_support: Target support may force coarse-state keep during warmup and first 80% of total training only; final 20% and ALL evaluation use predicted support alone. GaussianGPT decoder is always eval, target_key=None.
train.checkpoint_recovery: Atomic every50 updates, first update, final and caught exceptions/SIGTERM. Includes optimizer, sampler cursor, RNG and phase. No automatic resume.
train.occupancy_loss: Weighted BCE(raw_logit + log(positive_weight), label, pos_weight=positive_weight), positive_weight clipped to [1,50]; inference keeps raw_logit>0 using no target statistics.
train.exposure_comparison: Matches old batch1 x 3000 pair exposures; optimizer updates differ, so the old512 run is context rather than a controlled width-only ablation.

evaluation.arms: One user-selected LFQ native64 arm. Report all gates, including failures.
controls: Initial state held fixed, rendered at target camera
Frozen GaussianGPT encoding of target instant
Motion IDs circularly shifted by 85 start frames within the same clip
evaluation.regions: NeoVerse state protocol fixed workspace/object/hand-activity boxes
artifacts: motion features before/after quantization Bx4x64 (diagnostics only; not AR Z)
AR action Z: integer IDs Bx4; all177 frames yield176 transitions and704 IDs per sequence
replay packets containing initial continuous state andmotionIDs

stop: Any occupancy budget exceeded or empty predicted support
Target support outside initial-only candidate domain
retries: No automatic retry, no point/frame truncation, no scientific parameter retuning
limitations: Oracle posterior sees true target endpoint
NeoVerse is an offline whole-video noncausal teacher
Single historically DEV source already admitted to training; reconstruction only
State codec quality reported separately; motion may run diagnostically if state fidelity gate fails but API succeeds
State features are continuous and larger than prior LFQ packets; no discrete-state compression claim
The frozen state codec already failed its fidelity gate (31.267 vs teacher35.637 dB full-frame); this is a diagnostic motion experiment, not evidence of a usable full world model.
Native64 reduces interface conversion and model capacity simultaneously. Quality improvement is not assumed.

decoder_resource_limits.rationale: Output sparse convolution preserves coordinates after pruning; 600000 candidate voxels times existing multiplier 4 gives a consistent GS bound. No point truncation or pruning-threshold change.
